en-US.title: PawPair: Pet Care Tracker
en-US.subtitle: Dog & Cat Health Reminders
en-US.promoText: Keep every dog & cat healthy with 186 custom breed companions, smart daily routines, vet-ready health passports, and 100% private local care tracking.
en-US.description:
PawPair is a calm, private home for the everyday care, medication reminders, and health history of every dog and cat you love.

YOUR PET AT THE CENTER — 186 SUPPORTED BREEDS
Create personal companion profiles with custom artwork tailored to your exact dog or cat. From Golden Retrievers and French Bulldogs to Siamese cats and Maine Coons, PawPair celebrates your pet's individuality and keeps them at the heart of your day.

A CALM, EFFORTLESS DAILY RHYTHM
Plan meals, walks, water, medication, grooming, and appointments in an intuitive chronological timeline. See what is next at a glance and mark care moments complete with a single tap.

VET-READY HEALTH PASSPORT
Keep comprehensive, organized medical history right in your pocket. Track weight trends with visual charts, maintain vaccine and preventive care logs, monitor ongoing or resolved symptoms, and log vet notes. Prepare a focused, vet-ready health brief in seconds.

APPLE WATCH CARE ON YOUR WRIST
Glance at today's care progress, see upcoming tasks, and mark doses or walks done or skipped directly from Apple Watch. Offline changes queue safely and synchronize seamlessly when connected.

RELIABLE LOCAL REMINDERS
Never miss an important medication, meal, or vet appointment. Notifications are scheduled locally on your device with comfortable snooze controls and action buttons.

PORTABLE ENCRYPTED BACKUPS
Create password-protected backups that stay entirely in your control. Export, save, or restore through the native system file picker without needing third-party servers.

PAWPAIR PREMIUM
Unlock unlimited companion profiles and seamless caregiver handoff tools. Monthly and annual auto-renewable plans are available. Localized App Store pricing is displayed clearly with zero hidden fees.

100% PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your care data belongs to you. Pet profiles, medical records, and photos stay secure on your device. There are no advertisements, data brokers, or cross-app tracking.

BUILT WITH LOVE FOR IPHONE & APPLE WATCH
Enjoy smooth animations, dark/light adaptive aesthetics, comfortable touch targets, and full accessibility support.

PawPair is designed to assist in daily pet care organization and is not veterinary advice or an emergency service.

review.notes:
PawPair is a local-first pet care and health-history organizer for iPhone. No account or sign-in is required for core care, and the core app remains usable without a purchase. Optional Sign in with Apple enables private cloud synchronization.

Suggested free path

1. Create a dog named Atlas, breed Great Dane, date of birth 2022-05-14.
2. On Home, review the daily plan and complete a care moment.
3. Open Plan to add or edit a meal, walk, water, medication or custom routine.
4. Open Health to add weight, vaccine, symptom or appointment information.
5. Open Pets to switch companions or edit the active profile.
6. Open Settings to enable optional local reminders, create an encrypted portable backup, restore a selected backup, or choose Sign in with Apple for cloud sync.
7. After signing in, use Sync now in Settings. Pet profiles, routines, health records and private attachments are synchronized through PawPair's Supabase project. Settings > Delete account and data deletes the account, owned cloud snapshots and cloud attachments before clearing the device.

PawPair Premium

- Entitlement: premium
- Annual product: app.pawpair.medtracker.premium.annual
- Monthly product: app.pawpair.medtracker.premium.monthly
- Premium unlocks unlimited companion profiles and caregiver handoff tools.
- Open the Premium screen from the sparkle button in Pets, by attempting to add a second pet, or by opening Care handoff while on the free tier.
- Localized duration, renewal price and verified trial eligibility are loaded from the App Store through RevenueCat. If no verified offering loads, purchasing is disabled rather than showing a fallback price.
- Restore purchases, Terms and Privacy remain visible on the paywall.

Privacy and permissions

- Core care remains in the app sandbox. If the reviewer chooses Sign in with Apple, pet profiles, routines, health records and attachments also sync to PawPair's private Supabase project under account- and household-scoped access rules.
- Product analytics is optional, off by default and controlled from onboarding and Settings. It includes only allowlisted interaction events and installation identifiers; it never includes pet-care or health data.
- RevenueCat processes anonymous purchase history for subscription functionality, fraud prevention and subscription analytics. It does not receive pet-care data.
- There is no advertising or cross-app tracking.
- Notifications are local and optional. File selection, backup and sharing are user-initiated system actions.
- PawPair is not a veterinary or emergency service.

The internal Motion Lab is development-only and excluded from the production interface. Reduce Motion is respected for nonessential companion animation.
